title: Foundation Methods Portfolio Review Post-Session Decision Packet

note_sections.prompt: Record reviewer, learner, date, agenda used, and artifacts opened before critique.
Name the strongest visible outcomes and cite evidence refs rather than general impressions.
List required revisions, owners, priorities, and evidence refs for before/after proof.
Decide whether each gate check remains pending or can be copied from the gate status suggestion.
Preserve public-source uncertainty, missing classroom context, and unsupported inferences.
Specify the exact feedback import and learner gate status import edits to make after signing.

import_targets.target_action: Copy the feedback template row, then replace blank outcome, status update notes, revision items, and evidence refs from the signed packet.
Copy only satisfied, evidence-backed checks from the gate status suggestion after reviewer signature.
